title: Restore motion parity for scroll-revealed blocks
decision: Scroll-revealed Wix motion blocks are marked as entered via IntersectionObserver on the home route, setting data-motion-enter=done when elements intersect the viewport.
context: After migration, some lineup content stayed hidden because original Wix motion state transitions were no longer runtime-driven.
implementation: src/routes/+page.svelte detects motion candidates and observes viewport intersection.
When intersecting, element attribute data-motion-enter is set to done.
tests/e2e/home.spec.ts asserts lineup visibility, text presence, and motion-enter attribute state.
consequences: Keeps migrated behavior aligned with live Wix reveal expectations.
